strengths: Coverage verified by script against the 208-file tarball list: 208 rows, 208 unique, no duplicates, nothing missing or extra, and every migration target exists in the tree. No duplicate anchors, all anchors carry their domain prefix, no banned path substrings, and all 80 cross-links resolve.

Strongest anti-ossification design. No directory encodes a facet (level, form, era, season and review live only in particles). Closed vocabularies carry a recurrence rule (each value on at least 2 files and at most N/3), which matches the concept-singleton report in scripts/analyzers/spw-cut-gate.ts. The design also keeps a declared authored/computed boundary (panels/computed-kin and facet-census are prompts, never claims), and it leaves the Space facet visibly empty.

Richest discovery apparatus: panels/gap-table (domain x form and domain x level, computed next to authored gaps), a ^["gaps"] frame in every class index, affinity-atlas panels that each carry a ^[breaks] frame, a llull-wheel that crosses lens x domain x probe kind x era, and a corrections trail. The laryngeal-theory case in historical-linguistics is a real example of a gap that predicted a discovery, the same pattern as Mendeleev's table.

Most diverse script architectures: 15 closed forms, spread as claim_ledger 39, comparison_matrix 32, timeline_ladder 23, prerequisite_dag 17, glossary_lattice 15 and state_machine 14. Architecture diversity is itself an owner directive.

Best integrity contract. Every keystone claim is a Wikidata-style statement (value, qualifiers holds/fails/scope/as_of, src_ reference, rank). Refuted claims keep deprecated rank in three errata ledgers. The harm register is pointer-only and also covers nursing and community-care lines. #:review may never claim expert_reviewed.

Deepest tooling awareness, and it matches what the existing cut gate enforces: tagged ~< > path forms are banned, anchors inside #[] or .{} do not bind, expand resolves paths from the working directory first, spw graph reports file#anchor refs as broken, and leaf basenames stay unique for the atlas basename fallback (verified: no duplicates).

Source-grounded host and theory claims check out against the repo: 22 VS Code commands, 14 settings, Gradle 9.5, Kotlin 2.4.10, and git history starting 2026-01-08. The theory set adds address-and-linking and an epistemic-status state machine, both grounded in named code files.
weaknesses: Principle 1 caps path depth at 3 below the cut. That works against the owner's 'deep nesting where relevant' directive: the carrier and media ladders and development-and-ecology would fit a fourth level.

Parallelism has footguns. owns_dirs entries are declared non-recursive ('2026-09-30/' means root files only), so a naive reading makes 261 files multiply owned. The new_files figures (sum 150) do not match the 274 tree files. atlas-trails has to run last and cut-apparatus first, which serializes the two ends.
registries/quantities/index.spw and registries/sources/index.spw are missing, which breaks the contract rule that every directory has an index.spw.
Cross-class discovery is lower than it looks: only 40 of 80 cross-links cross a top-level class, and three trails (scroll-to-stream, particle-physics, editor-truth) stay inside one class.

Several good sources are collapsed. Four community-role raws merge into one roles-lattice, so the per-role dossiers are lost. Most taste files are dropped with a templated 'stance file with factual errors' reason, although the scorecard says to fold real stances (care of vulnerability, ethics of attention, labor dignity) into indexes as 3-5 lines.

Class names (formal, physical, record, making, learning) are less guessable than discipline names. The engineering math core is left as empty nodes, although econometrics, queueing, SPC and signals depend on it.

The season is scattered across one trail and five calendars in different classes. That is consistent with the facet doctrine, but it gives the Oct 1 -> Jan 4 arc less shape than Workshop does. Market hooks and well-known cases are also thinner than in Workshop.

A ladder.spw prerequisite DAG opens every part, propaedia/calendars/study-season-2026-q4 gives a 14-week study term, and every one of the 78 directories has an index.

Canonical-core dedupe with discipline framing kept: engineering/core holds solids, thermo, transport, control and signals, and physics holds single homes for thermal and EM. The engineering math core (probability, transforms, numerics, optimization) is filled rather than left empty.

Strongest kit for the story and for education: US curricula history in four files (generational timeline, policy ledger, curriculum-wars matrix, public-worry hooks whose cells stay to_verify) plus an intergenerational kit with an interview protocol, difference probes and an artifact dossier template.

Parallelizable: 16 packages whose prefix ownership is disjoint (verified, 0 overlaps), 16 to 25 files and 2.2k to 3.6k lines each, with anchors frozen up front and W01 blocking on vocabulary and contract.
weaknesses: Architecture monoculture: 118 of 250 leaves are 'field survey' (architecture entropy 3.23, the lowest of the three). This works against the directive to stress-test the language with diverse script architectures.
The single-value #:domain facet is overloaded: about 33 part indexes and ladders carry domain 'prop' (e.g., prop_ladder_mathematics). A facet query for domain=math therefore misses the math ladder.

Eight duplicate ladder.spw basenames. atlas.ts falls back to basename matching for unresolved refs (lines 150 and 171), so a broken ~"../ladder.spw" can silently resolve to another part's ladder and hide a dangling ref.

Harm routing is incomplete. harms-ledger lists only the 3 PD files. The new ecol nutrient-cycles-and-reference-values file (DRI/RDA/UL) sits next to supplement guidance and could drift into it.

Largest surface: 360 files and about 50.5k lines, 3.5x the raw lines, with 180 files written from scratch. That means the most unsourced-claim risk and the most gate load. It does not specify #:layer or #:review values or the probe_kind set, all of which the gate enforces.
Self-admitted hard taxonomy: 14 parts, one rung ladder across every field, and per-part ladders that duplicate needs edges and can drift.
Well-known cases are thin: only the film safety dossiers, the format-war state machine and the refpat dossiers. There is no Serial, Twitch Plays Pokemon or KU-style case set.

strengths: Migration checked from panel/colon/out.json: 208/208 covered, no duplicates, no extras, all targets in the tree, and every drop points at the manifest plus a successor index.

The most complete harm routing. Every harm-bearing raw file gets a pointer-only row in provenance/harm-register.spw that never restates doses, diets or protocols: the 3 quarantined PD files, circadian, developmental-stages, the 3 nursing reframes, care-and-health-stewards and ecological-and-spatial-stewards. The plants-development-care writer never reads the quarantined files. Nursing is written as a knowledge map with a guideline-currency rule and an honk guard in every leaf.

Best claim addressability. Each keystone claim is a Wikidata-style statement: an anchored value plus holds/fails/scope/as_of qualifiers, src_ references, and #:claim as rank. Refuted and superseded claims keep deprecated rank in three errata ledgers, and a corrections trail walks through them publicly. #:review never claims expert_reviewed for agent work, and a number appears in prose only next to a cited registry cell.

The most compatible with spw-cut-gate.ts as written. It specifies #:layer values (fixing the zero-information #!pragmatics), #:review values including code_verified, closed probe kinds, the canon lens set, and a recurrence rule that matches the gate's concept-singleton check. Its risk list anticipates rules the gate enforces: anchors inside #[] or .{} do not bind, tagged ~< > path forms do not parse, and a surface must pass parse().errors. Leaf basenames are unique apart from registry pairs, so the atlas basename fallback stays safe.

Host claims hold up against the source: 19 LSP providers and 22 VS Code commands match. It adds an LSP-surface registry and LSP defects (anchor jump to line 1, lens not indexed), which plugin theory needs.

The highest architecture diversity (entropy 3.75 for architecture, 3.47 for form): claim ledgers, matrices, ladders, DAGs, lattices, state machines, dossiers, cadences and calendars, with no dominant form.

The cut embodies the clustering hybrid and the reference-library patterns instead of only describing them: PMEST facet order, a Micropaedia glossary per class, panels/computed-kin and facet-census as generated prompts kept apart from authored claims, a Mendeleev gap table, a Llull wheel and a Mnemosyne atlas in which every panel has a ^[breaks] frame. It is the strongest anti-Wilkins stance: no directory encodes a facet.
weaknesses: The ownership spec is fragile. owns_dirs is declared non-recursive, so '2026-09-30/' (cut-apparatus) means root files only. Under ordinary prefix semantics 238 of 274 files would be multi-owned. The declared new_files total (150) also disagrees with the owned file count (274).
registries/quantities/ and registries/sources/ have no index.spw, which breaks the contract rule that every directory has an index with ^["tree"].

'Path depth at most 3' conflicts with the directive for deep nesting where relevant: sound, moving image and digital carriers are flattened into one record/carriers dir. #:domain has 50 values that mostly mirror paths, a risk the design names itself.

The engineering math core is left as empty gap nodes. That is honest, but the math lead shelf (named in the live caches index's ^"scrutiny" frame) stays thin. Canonical dedupe is weaker than Propaedia's: control and signals have no single home.

The season is spread across facets and scattered calendars, with no central dated calendar that marks fixed/typical/verify. Well-known cases are thin: only format wars and the Hull House/Foxfire-type role dossiers.

Two serialization points (cut-apparatus first, atlas-trails last). Computed panels need a generator that does not exist yet, so they start as stubs. The count of 23 spw/* methods is off by one against the 22 found in source, and writers must re-verify it by file:line.
Learnability: abstract class names plus PMEST citation order carry more conceptual load for a newcomer than a rung ladder does.
